# Look for stem-loops / terminators in 2850-3000 and anywhere
n=len(seq)
pairs = {"A":"T","T":"A","G":"C","C":"G"}
best_candidates=[]
for i in range(2800, n-20):
    for L in range(4, 9):
        a=i; b=i+L+4   # loop of 4
        if b>=n: continue
        arm=seq[a:a+L]
        comp = "".join(pairs[c] for c in reversed(arm))
        if seq[b:b+L]==comp:
            best_candidates.append((a+1, b+L, L))
print("simple inverted repeats (stem>=4, loop=4) in 2800-3000:", best_candidates[:10])
# broader
allhits=[]
for i in range(0, n-30):
    for L in range(4, 10):
        for loop in range(3,9):
            a=i; b=i+L+loop
            if b+L>n: continue
            arm=seq[a:a+L]
            comp="".join(pairs[c] for c in reversed(arm))
            if seq[b:b+L]==comp:
                allhits.append((a+1,b+L,L))
print("total IRs:", len(allhits))
print("last 10:", allhits[-10:] if allhits else "none")
# top ones with longest stem
allhits.sort(key=lambda x:-x[2])
print("longest:", allhits[:15])
